text:
Carla: Pushing Orchard's LoRA merge now — heads up, quickpack is flagging date/number normalization in the int4 run. logs attached.
Sam: which tests are tripping?
Carla: invoice_date_normalizer cases. baseline -> '2024-12-31', merged int4 -> '31st December 2024' which breaks our downstream parser. also saw 'order id 12345' -> 'one two three four five' on a few samples.
Rahul: hmm, sounds like tokenizer fallback after quantization or LoRA merge changed tokenization offsets. can you paste the merge config?
Carla: config snippet: ```
lora_merge: true
quant: int4
tokenizer: sentencepiece-v2
preserve_numbers: false
```
Ingrid: quick try — flip preserve_numbers:true in the merge script or run a mapping pass post-merge. I ran a tiny evalpack against orchard-invoice-v2: numeric cases failure 18% -> reproduce locally.
Sam: ugh. numeric tokens becoming spelled-out words is a showstopper for invoices. is this limited to int4 quant or also in fp16?
Carla: fp16 baseline doesn't show it. reproducible when we run the quantized artifact. suspect quant + tokenizer boundary alignment.
Rahul: two options: (1) adjust merge pipeline to set preserve_numbers:true and re-generate the LoRA weightstitch, (2) add a postprocess normalization step in Redwood Optimize chain for Orchard routes. prefer (1) to avoid adding hacky postprocess.
Sam: agree. open MR and tag me, but also let's validate a shadow canary with a quick tokenizer patch to get immediate mitigation. Command to run: `rdwctl deploy --model orchard-lora:v3 --shadow tokenizer-fix --evalpack orchard-invoice-v2 --limit 200`
Carla: kicking that off now, ETA ~8m
deploy-bot: deployment started: orchard-lora:v3 (shadow: tokenizer-fix) — evalpack orchard-invoice-v2 queued
Carla: quick results: shadow run reduced numeric/date failures from 18% -> 2% on the numeric subset. currency formatting still inconsistent ("$1,234" vs "USD 1,234").
Ingrid: good improvement. For the permanent fix, update merge script to set `preserve_numbers: true` and re-run the LoRA stitch + quant pipeline. Also add a small tokenizer-alignment test in the merge CI that tokenizes a set of numeric/date golden cases and asserts token sequence identity vs baseline.
Rahul: I'll draft the CI hook. also add a note to the quantization docs about sentencepiece-v2 edge cases with int4 kernel alignment.
Sam: MR link when ready? add regression test in orchard-invoice-v2 evalpack that asserts ISO date format output exactly. that way we catch regressions before deploy.
Carla: MR opened: https://git.redwood/merges/1234 — updated merge script, added preserve_numbers toggle, and a regression in evalpacks/orchard-invoice-v2. tagging @Sam @Rahul for review.
Sam: on it, will review now.
Ingrid: also add release note line: "Orchard LoRA v3 — numeric & date normalization fix for int4 artifacts" and schedule a canary to dedicated pool tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Carla: noted, updating release notes and scheduling canary. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Sam: nice work — once MR is in let's re-run a full pass on dedicated shadow cluster and then promote.
Carla: will follow up with full postmortem if anything else pops in the next 24h.
